  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative sentiment (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00) and recent prices are trending downward.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes by applying a 10-15% dampening factor to the immediate next period.",
    "When sentiment history includes positive sentiment (e.g., 0.33, 0.50, 0.67), increase forecast volatility to reflect bullish momentum, but cap upward revisions at +15% of recent mean.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction if forecast deviates >15% from 10-day moving average of historical prices.",
    "For horizon >15 days, reduce forecast sensitivity to sentiment if sentiment is neutral or weak (e.g., 0.00), to avoid overreaction to short-term noise.",
    "If true outcome consistently exceeds forecast by >5% over 3 consecutive days, reduce forecast by 2-3% per day to avoid overestimating downward momentum.",
    "When sentiment history shows increasing positivity (e.g., 0.00 → 0.33 → 0.50), adjust forecast upward with a lag of 2-3 days to reflect sentiment accumulation."
  ]
}
